page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c40g1.10xlarge is an x86_64 GPU-accelerated instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 40 dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 physical cores operating at 2.5 GHz, paired with 155.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 3.88 GB of RAM per core. Graphics and parallel computing workloads are accelerated by a single NVIDIA T4 GPU based on the Turing architecture, equipped with 16 GB of dedicated VRAM. This instance does not include local storage, requiring external network-attached storage solutions, and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear division between single-core and multi-core or GPU-accelerated capabilities. Single-core CPU performance is relatively weak, scoring in the bottom 10% to 25% in stress-ng and Geekbench tests. However, multi-core performance scales to average levels, as demonstrated by Geekbench and PassMark CPU scores. The system excels in GPU-driven tasks; LLM inference benchmarks show top-tier performance for prompt processing with both 135M and 7B parameter models, alongside strong text generation speeds for 7B models. Memory bandwidth and standard database operations remain within the average range.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, this instance offers a balanced entry point for GPU-accelerated workloads without the high cost overhead of top-tier enterprise GPUs. The combination of 40 dedicated cores and an NVIDIA T4 GPU makes it suitable for moderate machine learning inference, small-to-medium LLM deployment, video transcoding, and parallelized data processing. It is less optimal for single-threaded applications or workloads requiring high-speed local NVMe storage.
